beat_table.llm_evidence_quote: Rohan and Dinesh are part of the architecture now. No one will ever look there.
beat_table.llm_risk_reason: The concrete burial detail answers the opening mystery while creating a consequential secret and a clear danger of exposure.
beat_table.note: The concrete burial detail answers the opening mystery while creating a consequential secret and a clear danger of exposure.
beat_table.quote: **MEENAKSHI** (Driving steadily) Under the foundation of the new school gymnasium. They poured the concrete yesterday morning. Rohan and Dinesh are part of the architecture now. No one will ever look there.

beat_table.label: Malini's Counter-Leverage
beat_table.llm_evidence_quote: She also knows I have her son's police report hidden in a safe deposit box. Mutually assured destruction, Tara.
beat_table.llm_risk_reason: The new leverage prevents the danger from ending with the burial and gives the listener a concrete reason Malini is being contained.
beat_table.note: The new leverage prevents the danger from ending with the burial and gives the listener a concrete reason Malini is being contained.
beat_table.quote: **TARA** Malini looked like she wanted to kill you. **MEENAKSHI** She knows. But she also knows I have her son's police report hidden in a safe deposit box. Mutually assured destruction, Tara. She will never come near us again.

beat_table.label: The Bridge Disposal Order
beat_table.llm_evidence_quote: Get out. Bring the trash bags from the trunk.
beat_table.llm_risk_reason: The location change and direct command convert verbal cover-up into an immediate physical operation with exposed witnesses and evidence.
beat_table.note: The location change and direct command convert verbal cover-up into an immediate physical operation with exposed witnesses and evidence.
beat_table.quote: [SFX: The car pulls over to the side of a massive bridge. A roaring river rushes below.] **MEENAKSHI** Get out. Bring the trash bags from the trunk.

beat_table.label: Bloody Evidence at the Railing
beat_table.llm_evidence_quote: They carry two heavy black garbage bags—filled with bloody clothes and the blue tarps—to the railing.
beat_table.llm_risk_reason: The listener must track a concrete, high-stakes action while Tara's participation deepens her entanglement in the crime.
beat_table.note: The listener must track a concrete, high-stakes action while Tara's participation deepens her entanglement in the crime.
beat_table.quote: [SFX: Car doors open. The wind howls across the bridge. They carry two heavy black garbage bags—filled with bloody clothes and the blue tarps—to the railing.] **MEENAKSHI** On three. Throw it as far into the current as you can. One. Two. Three!

beat_table.label: The River Takes the Evidence
beat_table.llm_evidence_quote: The bags sail through the air, hitting the raging water below and immediately vanishing into the dark.
beat_table.llm_risk_reason: The evidence is removed quickly, but the apparent closure may reduce suspense because the immediate cleanup objective succeeds without interruption.
beat_table.note: The evidence is removed quickly, but the apparent closure may reduce suspense because the immediate cleanup objective succeeds without interruption.
beat_table.quote: [SFX: The bags sail through the air, hitting the raging water below and immediately vanishing into the dark.] **TARA** (Crying softly, finally relieved) It's over. It's really over.

beat_table.label: A Mother’s Future Promise
beat_table.llm_evidence_quote: You are going to graduate. You are going to go to a good college. You will have a beautiful life.
beat_table.llm_risk_reason: The emotional reassurance gives the cleanup a personal objective and pays off Tara's earlier fear with a direct bond between mother and daughter.
beat_table.note: The emotional reassurance gives the cleanup a personal objective and pays off Tara's earlier fear with a direct bond between mother and daughter.
beat_table.quote: **MEENAKSHI** Yes. Look at me, Tara. You are going to graduate. You are going to go to a good college. You will have a beautiful life. **TARA** I will, Ma. I promise.

beat_table.label: Grading After the Cover-Up
beat_table.llm_evidence_quote: Good. Now get in the car. We have grading to do before Monday.
beat_table.llm_risk_reason: The abrupt move from murdered victims and discarded bloody evidence to routine grading can feel like closure rather than a new unanswered threat, especially for listeners seeking continued suspense.
